definitions.explanation: to use money or funds entrusted to one for personal purposes; to misuse funds

definitions.explanation: to use something repeatedly until it becomes familiar and comfortable, or until one becomes proficient with it

notes:
{使|つか}い{込|こ}む has two distinct meanings.

SENSE 1 - EMBEZZLEMENT:
- Using funds that belong to others for personal purposes
- Often appears in news about financial crimes
- Related to ⟦{横領|おうりょう}→横領：09001_ouryou⟧ (embezzlement)

SENSE 2 - WEARING IN:
- Using something until it becomes comfortable or shows character
- Positive connotation: appreciation for well-used items
- Common with leather goods, tools, musical instruments

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
Sense 1:
- ⟦{公金|こうきん}→公金：29287_koukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{込|こ}む (to embezzle public funds)
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{使|つか}い{込|こ}む (to embezzle company money)

Sense 2:
- {使|つか}い{込|こ}まれた～ (well-used ~)
- {使|つか}い{込|こ}むほど (the more you use it)

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for money/items.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{果|は}たす→使い果たす：07667_tsukaihatasu⟧ (to use up completely)
- ⟦{使|つか}い{慣|な}れる→使い慣れる：07877_tsukainareru⟧ (to become accustomed to using)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in both news and everyday contexts.
